value.body: The Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test (NORCET) is conducted by AIIMS New Delhi to fill Nursing Officer posts at AIIMS institutions and some other central government hospitals. Nursing Officers provide ward, ICU, operation-theatre and emergency nursing care.

items.label: Age limit
items.note: Relaxation for reserved categories as per rules

value.title: How you get in
value.body: B.Sc (Hons) Nursing, B.Sc Nursing or Post-Basic B.Sc Nursing — or a GNM diploma with two years' experience in a hospital of at least 50 beds — plus registration as a nurse and midwife with a State or Indian Nursing Council. Selection is by computer-based tests run by AIIMS New Delhi; posts are allotted by merit and preference.

value.title: At a glance
items: The exam has been held about twice a year recently, with one merit list used across many institutes.
Allotment can be to a newer AIIMS far from home, with limited choice.
Work is in rotating shifts, including nights.
Other central and state hospitals recruit nursing officers through their own exams.
